_comment: The board's change log. Newest entry first — the board shows them in the order they appear here and marks the top one as the latest. Add an entry by copying the shape below; 'date' is what the board prints, 'notes' is a list of lines. Nothing here is validated against the code, so it says whatever you write.

entries.title: What's new
notes: -belford is ny waterway's now, not seastreak's. new times are on the board from the 8th, weekends from the 12th
-the belford boat calls at pier 11 instead of the battery maritime building, so it shows at pier 11 now
-seastreak's whole timetable changed too. new weekday times from the 8th, new weekend times from the 12th
-seastreak stops at brookfield place now, so battery park city shows those boats
-seastreak no longer calls at pier 79, sandy hook or paulus hook, so those boats are off the board
-the last seastreak boat of the night leaves earlier mon-wed than it does thu-fri. the board knows which day it is
